source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: DeepSeek proposes a browser-driven GPUBB upload/start/wait operation with host off, followed by the mandatory AC cycle and GPUBB version check.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: WebUI screenshots/status and pre/post GPUBB version, with an unsupported clean-single-reset statement.
deepseek_columns.risk: DeepSeek identifies the GPUBB write, interruption and AC-cycle hazards.

original_test_intent: Have an engineer upgrade and downgrade the GPU baseboard firmware through the BMC WebUI while the host begins off, then perform the required AC cycle and demonstrate both active GPUBB firmware and restored GPU fabric, enumeration and health.
original_method: The Master method is attended GPUBB WebUI programming followed by AC removal/restoration. The linked `check_gpu_nvidia` repository may assess GPU presence or health, but it is not the flash method and cannot be assumed to read the GPUBB firmware version without inspecting its platform-specific outputs.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer selects and confirms the GPUBB image in WebUI, observes terminal programming status, and authorizes or performs the controlled AC cycle. The agent can prepare immutable GPU/board baselines and analyze evidence but does not operate those core controls.
required_inputs: GPUBB PN/revision, GPU tray topology and current/target firmware versions
signed upgrade/downgrade packages with hashes and supported order
vendor WebUI programming, safe-to-remove-power and activation procedure
approved AC controller, dwell/count and host/BMC recovery sequence
expected GPU UUID/PCIe/NVLink topology, driver/VBIOS state, diagnostics and XID/kernel/SEL criteria
safety_requirements: Bind the package to the exact GPUBB and installed GPU topology; never infer compatibility from the filename or assume GPU indices are stable.
Do not remove AC until the WebUI reaches the documented terminal and safe-to-cycle state; initial host-off with BMC standby is not the same as full AC loss.
Before cycling, record every GPU by UUID/PCIe path and active jobs/users; use topology identity rather than ordinal indices for post-AC comparison.
A successful WebUI banner or GPUBB version is insufficient if GPUs disappear, links degrade or XID/kernel/SEL faults appear after activation.
Preserve the first flash, power or GPU-fabric failure and never reflash, reverse direction or repeat the AC cycle automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Capture GPUBB/platform identity, GPU UUID/PCIe/NVLink topology, driver/VBIOS, active processes, XID/kernel and BMC/SEL baselines before the manual operation.
After the engineer's AC cycle, verify authoritative GPUBB inventory and correlate all GPUs by UUID/topology, link state, diagnostics, driver health, XID/kernel and platform logs.
Inspect and qualify the linked GPU script's actual checks before accepting its output; report evidence without operating WebUI/power or assigning PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform each GPUBB WebUI image transition and exact AC-cycle hand-off.
Judge both firmware activation and complete GPU-fabric recovery, then issue separate upgrade and downgrade verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It retains the correct GPUBB/off-state/AC lifecycle but unqualified browser driving violates ED-25, and its version-plus-clean-reset evidence does not prove GPU topology or link recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor GPUBB WebUI manually, wait for safe-to-cycle, run the approved AC procedure, then combine authoritative GPUBB inventory with UUID/topology-based GPU diagnostics.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: GPUBB target, WebUI method, initial host-off state, mandatory AC cycle, named GPU script and 5/30-minute values remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED GPUBB WEB UPDATE WITH GPU-FABRIC AC VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind one signed image to the exact GPUBB/GPU platform, capture engineer-owned WebUI terminal state, perform controlled AC activation after the safe-power gate, and compare active GPUBB firmware plus GPU UUID/PCIe/NVLink topology, diagnostics and fault logs against baseline.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: GPU baseboards whose vendor BMC WebUI supports GPUBB programming and requires AC activation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record GPUBB board/image, GPU SKU/VBIOS, BMC/WebUI/browser, driver/diagnostic script, fabric manager and AC-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor GPUBB programming, GPU-fabric validation, AC activation and recovery documentation plus project power SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable GPU identity/topology, safe-power evidence, fault-log checks and recovery gates without replacing the WebUI action.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An alternate approved updater may prove a project GPUBB transition but not the source WebUI path; version equality cannot prove GPU links or enumeration recovered.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved GPUBB/GPU compatibility and AC plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GPU ordering may change across AC; compare UUID and physical topology, not assumed indices.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may select another approved update tool, diagnostic suite or AC controller, but must record original WebUI versus actual method, reason, approval, equivalent checkpoints and unverified WebUI coverage. Completion is limited to the named GPUBB/GPU topology.
expected_evidence: approved GPUBB board/GPU topology/version/image matrix with hashes and signatures
host-off/BMC-standby baseline including GPU UUID/PCIe/NVLink topology, driver/VBIOS, active processes and XID/kernel/SEL
engineer-owned WebUI selection, confirmation, progress, terminal status and safe-to-cycle evidence
AC controller, dwell and timestamped power telemetry
post-AC authoritative GPUBB version plus matched GPU UUID/topology, link/diagnostic, driver and fault-log evidence
recovery readiness and separate engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently name GPUBB WebUI programming followed by AC activation. Exact packages, GPU topology and power timing are Project SPEC inputs; DeepSeek's clean-single-reset addition is not imported.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The GPUBB target, interface and activation lifecycle are understandable. Missing artifacts and expected values are readiness inputs; engineer-operated WebUI and AC actions make the complete case MANUAL ONLY rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes PARTIAL to MANUAL ONLY, preserves GPUBB/off-state/AC scope, and replaces generic version evidence with UUID/topology/fault-aware GPU acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its GPU and recovery safeguards while removing permanent BLOCKED because exact packages and power values can be supplied by Project SPEC.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms manual ownership and strengthens the linked GPU script boundary instead of relying on the archived conclusion.

review_improvement: Makes a GPUBB update successful only when the full GPU fabric returns with matching identities, links and clean fault evidence after AC activation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A GPUBB image can report the requested version while one or more GPUs or fabric links fail initialization. Therefore the acceptance must correlate GPUs by UUID and physical topology and inspect link/driver/XID evidence after AC. The project can supply images and timing without redefining the purpose, but WebUI operation and power control remain engineer-owned manual core work.
